business.body: Damodar Industries Limited manufactures a diversified portfolio of premium and value-added yarns, including cotton, melange, specialty, slub and multi-blend varieties. The Company serves both domestic and international markets, catering to apparel, home textiles, knitting and fashion applications. Backed by over four decades of experience, it focuses on product innovation, operational excellence and sustainable manufacturing through advanced spinning technologies and a dedicated R&D centre.

outlook.body:
- Operate in the textile segment with a risk management policy focused on controlling and mitigating operational risks such as cotton price fluctuation, foreign exchange rate fluctuation, labour problems, and regulatory risks related to government policy for the textile industry.
- The Board of Directors has not recommended a dividend. An amount of Rs.20 crores was transferred to the General Reserve out of the Profit available for appropriation.
- The Company has a Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) policy and undertook CSR initiatives during the year, with details set out in Annexure-III of the Board's Report.
- The Company has zero tolerance for sexual harassment and has adopted a 'Respect for Gender' Policy, with an Internal Committee constituted under the POSH Act; no cases were filed during 2025-26.
- The Company has established a vigil mechanism for directors and employees to report genuine concerns, providing direct access to the Chairman of the Audit Committee and Managing Director.
